scene: The wound finch chirps, unlocking three hidden transit stations across the platform.
picture: Side-scrolling wide view of the rooftop platform under early evening twilight. The player in teal bomber jacket stands centre beside the windmill vane. At far left rests a brass book cart lift over a chute. To the right idles a purple night bus, and at far right waits an open carnival gondola.
shown: an open-topped brass book cart lift waiting on rails at the far left
a sleek purple night bus parked idling at the platform curb on the right
a striped ferris wheel gondola hanging stationary beside a boarding gate at the far right
